title: Listen to a pack
description: Expand a release, play its exact queue, choose a file and open the fullscreen pack player.

steps.caption: 1. Find Night Sessions in Dub Vault. Each pack is one release card.
2. Show tracks reveals numbered files in the release order.
3. Play all starts this pack only. Next, shuffle and repeat stay inside its playlist.
4. Open pack moves to the fullscreen player with the same queue and current track.
5. Next track selects the next file in this pack. Enable repeat to loop the pack.
6. Close the fullscreen view to minimize it without stopping your listening session.
